name: Proxmox LXC Antigravity Remote Control
description: Google Antigravity CLI configured for headless Remote Control. Runs the persistent antigravity-cli-daemon systemd user service inside an unprivileged LXC container so you can connect to and drive autonomous agent sessions from the Antigravity Remote Control web dashboard.

notes.text: Complete first-run sign-in as the antigravity user: run 'su --whitelist-environment=SSH_CONNECTION,SSH_CLIENT,SSH_TTY - antigravity', sign in with 'SSH_TTY="$(tty)" agy', stop with '/exit', and run 'agy remote-control start --name "<instance-name>"'.
Access the container from https://antigravity.google.com using the same Google Account.
Do a check of daemon status with 'agy remote-control status' and read logs with 'journalctl --user -u antigravity-cli-daemon -n 50' as the antigravity user.
The install script writes terminal sandbox defaults to settings.json. The CT script can also add a Proxmox VE LAN-isolation firewall (ANTIGRAVITY_BLOCK_LAN=yes).
